subject.title: [OAuth] Client ID revoked `app_EMoamEEZ73f0CkXaXp7hrann` - fresh ChatGPT Plus logins completely broken

question: Should OpenClaw replace or override the upstream-default OpenAI ChatGPT OAuth client ID, and who owns registering or approving the replacement OAuth application?
rationale: OpenClaw and upstream Codex both currently use the reported client ID, but any replacement must come from a maintainer/vendor-owned OAuth app with matching redirect, device-code, and refresh behavior.

options.title: Coordinate a client rotation
options.body: Register or approve a replacement OpenAI OAuth app, update browser and device-code flows as needed, and capture fresh-login plus refresh proof.

options.title: Keep upstream default until proven
options.body: Keep the current client ID open for investigation until maintainers reproduce the invalid-client failure or OpenAI confirms revocation.

options.title: Temporarily disable the flow
options.body: Hide or clearly fail ChatGPT OAuth and point users to a supported alternative if no valid client is available soon.

recommendation.title: Coordinate a client rotation
recommendation.body: Register or approve a replacement OpenAI OAuth app, update browser and device-code flows as needed, and capture fresh-login plus refresh proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available feature-history route for this OpenAI provider-auth surface is the merged provider-unification and recent boundary work by steipete.
